signalingTimeline.description: Viewer client sends UpdateSubscription(subscribe=false) to unsubscribe prior screen track (TR_VSrzKShmnkBXFk)
Viewer client sends UpdateSubscription(subscribe=true) to subscribe new screen track (TR_VSXCz9gNonkGAP)
Playwright begins 3000ms waitForTimeout in receiveOne(); before-stats recorded with videoCount=0
Gateway finishes lockedLease transaction and forwards unsubscribe frame to upstream SFU (603ms queue/process delay)
Gateway finishes second lockedLease transaction and forwards subscribe frame to upstream SFU (1481ms cumulative delay)
Viewer client generates SDP Offer for renegotiation and sends SignalRequest(offer) to gateway
Gateway forwards SDP Offer to upstream SFU (1486ms gateway queue/lockedLease delay)
Playwright 3000ms waitForTimeout expires; after-stats recorded; expect(videoCount).toBe(1) FAILS
Upstream SFU responds with SDP Answer (SFU processing took 594ms from offer forward)
Gateway forwards SDP Answer to viewer client; arrives 696ms after measurement window closed

latencyDecomposition.criticalDelayAttribution: Gateway queue drain serialization (2967ms) pushed SDP answer completion 696ms past the 3818ms measurement window.

provenFactors.evidence: Frame 81 and 83 arrived 5ms apart but were drained in separate serial batches (603ms and 883ms), each executing BEGIN, liveLease, rooms FOR SHARE, call_groups FOR SHARE, liveLease, liveLeaseWithPolicy, and COMMIT.
provenFactors.impact: 1481ms delay before subscription frame reached upstream SFU.

provenFactors.evidence: Client SDP offer received at 1791725216744 was delayed 1486ms before forwarding at 1791725218230.
provenFactors.impact: SFU could not begin generating SDP answer until 3652ms into the 3818ms window.

provenFactors.factor: Uninterrupted gateway health and zero error counts
provenFactors.evidence: 0 query errors, 0 RPC errors, 0 dropped records, pool idle settled. Failure was pure signaling latency, not database crash or timeout 57014.
provenFactors.impact: Rules out unhandled exception, crash, or gateway closure as the failure mode.

unprovenOrGaps.gap: Gateway observer logged case 'subscriptionPermissionUpdate' and byte count, but did not decode whether allowed was true/false or whether client renegotiation waited on this signal.
Slow query logging only catches queries > 1000ms. Aggregate query execution time across the 8 queries per batch is inferred from batch duration, not individual span traces.
Mean CPU 85.20% and min RAM 1.88 GB correlate with high load, but cannot be claimed as unique root cause.
